spec_type_rationale: Extends an existing mature renderer: composes the Tabs molecule, adds an activeSubTab field + setActiveSubTab action to the existing tabsStore, mounts into the existing Shell request pane. Similar features (TabBar, RequestBar, KVTable) + type defs (RequestSpec, Tab) exist — not greenfield scaffolding.

findings.content: organisms->molecules downward import only; domain-bound components in organisms/, subfolder only at >=2 components. RequestSubTabs is a lone organism singleton (like TabBar) composing the Tabs molecule.
Never mutate zustand state outside a store action -> the activeSubTab write MUST be a tabsStore action (setActiveSubTab).
Never use inline styles; prefer design tokens (tokens.css) over literals; compose classes with cx(). Fidelity via semantic classes bound to tokens.css.
renderer-only: no Node/Electron imports; cross-module imports via @renderer alias.
co-located tests under __tests__/: .test.tsx (Vitest) + .ct.tsx (Playwright CT); cover ACs incl edge/error paths.
A CSS shortcut (justify-content) masked height+color drift; structural fix was the real one. T5d pane-tab fidelity must fix structurally, not paper over with layout hacks.

CT fidelity tests must reproduce full styling context: tokens.css import + data-theme/data-mstyle + production className scope (e.g. .tabbar). T5d CT needs the .pane-tabs production scope + tokens + both themes.
Sub-1% color changes stay within Playwright threshold so --update-snapshots leaves baselines stale; prefer computed-style equality over screenshot pixels for discrete tokens.

design/reference.html -> /breakdown emits design-manifest.json + per-element fidelity disposition; /implement runs a static design-token provenance check. T5d has a design source so the manifest + token-provenance gate apply.
typecheck = typecheck:node + typecheck:web; lint = eslint --cache; renderer tests = Vitest (.test.tsx) + Playwright CT (.ct.tsx). Verification commands draw from these.
organisms are domain singletons; molecules are shared. RequestSubTabs (request-domain) is an organism; Tabs (shared) the molecule it composes.

tabsStore owns tabs: Tab[], activeTabId, lifecycle; updateActiveSpec shallow-merges a partial RequestSpec, no-op when unchanged (dirty never flips spuriously). Tab record: {id, collectionRequestId, spec, dirty}. TabBar=lifecycle subscriber; RequestBar=spec-edit subscriber.

Tabs is hand-rolled WAI-ARIA (role=tablist/tab, roving tabindex, Arrow/Home/End wrap, disabled-skip), controlled (activeId+onChange), selection-only — NEVER renders panels. TabDescriptor supports badge (string|number), method, dirty, disabled. T5d composes it and owns the tabpanels.

TabBar passes className='tabbar'; Tabs.css carries a .tabbar-scoped override block re-treating geometry/active/hover. Precedent for T5d styling: pass className='pane-tabs' + a .pane-tabs-scoped override to hit §6 pane-tab fidelity values.

KVTable reads tabsStore directly via a field:'params'|'headers' prop (self-subscribing; not passed rows); validVars defaults to envVars() sentinel. T5d Params/Headers slot is <KVTable field='params'/> / field='headers'/> — the slot is the component instance; mounting keeps its own focus/edit state.

App.tsx renders <Shell tabs={<TabBar/>} panes={{request:<RequestBar/>}}/>; ShellProps.panes forwards to PaneSplit request?:ReactNode (single slot, rendered without inspection). Mounting T5d = App.tsx replaces panes.request with the composed pane.
.pane-tab: height 36px, gap 6px, color var(--text-muted), font-size 12.5px, font-weight 500, margin-right 14px. Active tab color var(--text).
.pane-tab .badge: font-size 10px, background var(--bg-active), color var(--text-muted), border-radius 999px, padding 1px 6px, font-weight 600.
.pane-tab.active .badge: background var(--accent-soft), color var(--accent) — active-state badge recolor is a distinct fidelity target.
.pane-tabs: display flex, align-items center, gap 2px, padding 0 16px, border-bottom 1px solid var(--border-faint), height 36px, position relative.
Active indicator = .pane-tab.active::after: absolute, left0/right0, bottom -1px, height 1.5px, background var(--accent). Scoped override, static (not animated).

var(--token) resolves-to-token: --accent #10b981; --accent-soft=color-mix(in oklab, accent 14%, transparent); --bg-active #e8e6e3/#25252a; --text-muted #6c6c75/#a1a1aa; --text #18181b/#f4f4f5; --border-faint #f0efed/#1c1c1f. Per-theme assertion required.

Tabs API: controlled activeId + onChange(id) once on click/keyboard; flat descriptor array (id,label,badge?,disabled?); Arrow/Home/End wrap, skip disabled; optional right actions slot; aria-selected + tablist/tab roles + roving tabindex.
002 explicitly anticipated the request-pane six-tab and response-pane four-tab consumers. T5d IS the request-pane six-tab consumer 002 was built for.
002 leaves panels out (selection-only, never renders panels) and ships no animated sliding underline (static). T5d owns tabpanels + aria wiring; active underline is a static scoped ::after.
Store field on Tab record + mount-all container: activeSubTab enum (default 'params') on the Tab record + setActiveSubTab(tabId,key) action in tabsStore.
Mount-all + toggle-visibility (CSS), NOT unmount, to preserve KVTable edit state (focus/scroll/half-typed row). Buy rejected: react-tabs/Radix unmount inactive. Zero new deps.

T5d is a VIEW over a store field: must react to EXTERNAL setActiveSubTab writes (open-on-sub-tab flows T18/T19/T20), not just its own click. IN: react to any activeSubTab change; OUT: implement the jump-flows.

State-preservation CT is go/no-go (focus Params cell -> switch Headers -> back -> same DOM node keeps focus). Read §6 numbers from styles.css at CT-writing time. Empty-slot sub-tabs are FULL tabs, not disabled.
Absent/invalid activeSubTab -> VALID_KEYS.includes(v)?v:'params'; no active tab -> neutral render no crash; huge badge count -> '99+'; malformed spec -> defensive reads (spec.params?.length ?? 0).

decision_points.description: Does T5d wire into the running app now (mounted in Shell's request pane below RequestBar) or ship built + CT-tested in isolation like KVTable/014?
decision_points.user_answer: Mount into the running app now: App.tsx replaces panes.request (<RequestBar/>) with a composed request pane (RequestBar + RequestSubTabs below it); Params/Headers slots -> <KVTable field=.../>, other 4 -> shared empty-state. This ALSO lands KVTable/014's deferred app-mount in the same step (KVTable goes live through T5d's slots). Rationale: breaks the defer-forever isolate-first chain — T5d is the first point where mounting is meaningful (the container that makes the request pane whole).

decision_points.description: Empty-state presentation for the 4 unbuilt-panel slots (Auth/Body/Tests/Code)
decision_points.user_answer: Neutral 'not yet available' text: ONE shared empty-state tabpanel with muted text ('Panel not yet available') styled via --text-muted, the SAME for all 4 unbuilt slots (not personalized). Satisfies valid-non-empty-ARIA-tabpanel; zero design debt; no deletion when panels arrive (slot ?? empty-state is one condition). NOT blank (reads as breakage), NOT icon+label placeholder (the throwaway 'coming soon' barred by non-goals).

mandatory_reads.n_a_reason: Local desktop UI feature — no REST/GraphQL API operations; data flows through the in-renderer tabsStore/RequestSpec.

overview: RequestSubTabs is a per-request-tab container/switcher for the request pane: a horizontal strip of 6 fixed sub-tabs (Params, Auth, Headers, Body, Tests, Code) with RequestSpec-derived badges that switches which editor panel is visible below. It composes the existing Tabs molecule (002) for the switcher (a11y/keyboard/badge render), owns the 6 mounted tabpanels (mount-all + toggle-visibility to preserve panel state), and is backed by a new activeSubTab field + setActiveSubTab action on tabsStore. It implements no panel body itself — Params/Headers slots receive the existing KVTable (014); the other 4 slots show one shared empty-state until their panels land. This feature also mounts the composed request pane (RequestBar + RequestSubTabs) into the Shell, taking KVTable live through the Params/Headers slots. Visual fidelity to design/reference.html section 6 (Pane tabs) is mandatory.
current_state: The request pane currently renders only the RequestBar. App.tsx (src/renderer/src/App.tsx:6) composes the shell as Shell tabs={TabBar} panes={{ request: RequestBar }}; Shell (src/renderer/src/components/organisms/shell/Shell.tsx:110 ShellProps.panes) forwards panes to PaneSplit, whose request slot (src/renderer/src/components/organisms/shell/PaneSplit.tsx:49 PaneSplitProps.request?: ReactNode) renders its content without inspection. The Tabs molecule (src/renderer/src/components/molecules/Tabs.tsx:382; TabDescriptor at :135) is a hand-rolled WAI-ARIA, controlled (activeId + onChange), selection-only strip that never renders panels; TabDescriptor already supports badge (string|number), disabled, method, dirty, plus an optional right-aligned actions slot. TabBar (src/renderer/src/components/organisms/TabBar.tsx:112) is the canonical composition template: per-field tabsStore selectors -> useMemo(descriptors) -> Tabs activeId onChange className='tabbar' actions; Tabs.css carries a .tabbar-scoped override block. tabsStore (src/renderer/src/lib/tabsStore.ts) owns tabs: Tab[], activeTabId, and lifecycle actions (openFromCollection, newBlank, close, selectActive, markClean, updateActiveSpec — shallow-merge, no-op when unchanged so dirty never flips spuriously); the Tab record is {id, collectionRequestId, spec, dirty} (makeBlankTab at tabsStore.ts:138) with NO activeSubTab field today. requestSpec (src/renderer/src/lib/requestSpec.ts:70 RequestSpec; Auth union at :63; makeBlankRequest at :124) is a pure data module exposing method/url/params/headers/body/auth. KVTable (src/renderer/src/components/organisms/KVTable.tsx:26) is a self-subscribing organism: KVTable({ field: 'params'|'headers' }) reads the active tab's spec[field] from tabsStore directly and writes via updateActiveSpec; it is built + CT-tested but not yet mounted into the running app. Design tokens live in tokens.css; fidelity targets are pre-resolved in design/styles.css (.pane-tabs / .pane-tab / .badge) and design/design-fidelity-contract.md section 6.
desired_behavior: Add a new RequestSubTabs organism at src/renderer/src/components/organisms/RequestSubTabs.tsx (+ sibling RequestSubTabs.css) that composes the Tabs molecule for a 6-sub-tab strip (Params, Auth, Headers, Body, Tests, Code — fixed order, all always visible and switchable, none disabled/hidden). The active sub-tab is per-request-tab state: add activeSubTab (enum 'params'|'auth'|'headers'|'body'|'tests'|'code', default 'params') to the Tab record and a setActiveSubTab(tabId, key) action to tabsStore. RequestSubTabs reads activeTabId + that tab's activeSubTab and renders Tabs activeId={activeSubTab} onChange={key => setActiveSubTab(activeTabId, key)} className='pane-tabs'; it never mutates the RequestSpec. Badges derive read-only from the active RequestSpec (params count, headers count, auth-set) and update reactively when the spec changes; a badge shows only where the spec carries a value (Body/Tests/Code typically none); counts above 99 display as 99+. All 6 tabpanels are mounted at once and hidden via CSS (display toggle), never unmounted, so panel state (KVTable focus/scroll/half-typed row, open inline edits) survives a sub-tab switch. Params and Headers panels are KVTable field='params' and KVTable field='headers'; the other 4 slots show ONE shared neutral empty-state (muted 'Panel not yet available' text via --text-muted) — the same empty-state for all four, not personalized. Each tabpanel carries role='tabpanel' with aria-controls/aria-labelledby linking it to its tab and aria-selected mirroring activeSubTab. RequestSubTabs reacts identically to its own click and to an external setActiveSubTab write. Invalid or absent activeSubTab reads back as 'params' (VALID_KEYS.includes(v) ? v : 'params'); with no active tab the strip renders a neutral empty region without crashing. Visual fidelity matches design/styles.css section 6 exactly in both light and dark themes. Finally, wire the composed request pane into the app: App.tsx replaces panes.request (RequestBar) with the composed pane (RequestBar + RequestSubTabs below it), taking KVTable live through the Params/Headers slots.

Add a SubTabKey enum + activeSubTab field (default 'params') to the Tab record (makeBlankTab), and a setActiveSubTab(tabId,key) store action
Replace panes.request (<RequestBar/>) with the composed request pane (RequestBar + RequestSubTabs); this takes KVTable live through the Params/Headers slots
Composed as-is via activeId/onChange/badge/actions API — no modification; consumed by RequestSubTabs
Mounted into the Params/Headers slots as <KVTable field='params'/> / field='headers'/>; no component change — it goes live through T5d
Read-only source for badge derivation (params/headers count, auth-set); no change
Consumed by RequestSubTabs.css for the §6 pane-tab fidelity values (--text-muted/--text/--accent/--accent-soft/--bg-active/--border-faint); verify tokens present, no new token expected

acceptance_criteria.statement: The renderer shall provide a RequestSubTabs container component module under the organisms directory.
The RequestSubTabs component shall ship a sibling token-bound stylesheet.
The build shall add no third-party tab library dependency.
WHILE the new activeSubTab field is present on the Tab record, the existing tabsStore consumers TabBar and RequestBar shall continue to behave as before.
The RequestSubTabs component shall compose the Tabs molecule through its existing public API without modifying the Tabs selection-only contract.
WHEN the user selects a sub-tab by click or by Arrow/Home/End keyboard navigation, the RequestSubTabs component shall make that sub-tab active and show its tabpanel while hiding the others.
WHEN a sub-tab is activated, the RequestSubTabs component shall persist the selection only through the setActiveSubTab store action.
WHILE two request tabs hold different active sub-tabs, the RequestSubTabs component shall restore each request tab's own active sub-tab when the user switches away and back.

WHILE the user switches between sub-tabs, the RequestSubTabs component shall keep all 6 tabpanels mounted and toggle their visibility with CSS so panel state such as input focus, scroll position, and a half-typed row is preserved.
WHEN setActiveSubTab is written externally rather than by a click inside RequestSubTabs, the RequestSubTabs component shall update the strip and the visible tabpanel identically to a local click.
The Params and Headers sub-tabs shall render the KVTable bound to the respective RequestSpec field.
WHILE a sub-tab has no panel supplied, the RequestSubTabs component shall render one shared neutral empty-state tabpanel using muted text so all 4 unbuilt sub-tabs share the same empty-state.
The RequestSubTabs component shall render all 6 sub-tabs as reachable, focusable tabs with none disabled or hidden.
WHILE mounted, the RequestSubTabs component shall give each tabpanel role tabpanel with aria-controls and aria-labelledby linking it to its tab and aria-selected mirroring the active sub-tab.
WHEN a sub-tab badge count exceeds 99, the RequestSubTabs component shall display the badge as 99+.
IF the stored active sub-tab value is absent or not a valid sub-tab key, THEN the RequestSubTabs component shall treat the active sub-tab as params.
IF there is no active request tab, THEN the RequestSubTabs component shall render a neutral empty region without throwing.
The App shall mount the composed request pane of RequestBar above RequestSubTabs into the request pane slot.
The exported RequestSubTabs component, the SubTabKey type, and the setActiveSubTab action shall carry documentation comments.
The renderer source shall pass strict type-checking.
The codebase shall pass ESLint without new errors.
The RequestSubTabs source shall contain no inline style attributes.
The RequestSubTabs source shall not import the electron or node modules.
The RequestSubTabs source shall not call updateActiveSpec, keeping sub-tab interaction free of any RequestSpec mutation.
The RequestSubTabs source shall import no unbuilt panel component, receiving all panels as slot props.
WHEN the active RequestSpec changes its params headers or auth data, the RequestSubTabs component shall update the corresponding sub-tab badge reactively without a sub-tab switch.
WHILE rendered under the light theme or the dark theme, the RequestSubTabs strip shall match the section 6 pane tab computed style targets for both themes.

ac_subsection_na.ci_pipeline: No CI pipeline changes; tests run via existing npm scripts, not a new pipeline stage.
ac_subsection_na.hooks_gates: No new git hooks or commit gates introduced by this feature.

out_of_scope.content: Implementing the Auth, Body, Tests, or Code panel bodies — those are separate features; T5d only provides their slots + shared empty-state
Reorderable / closable / addable sub-tabs, overflow menus, and per-sub-tab context actions — the 6-tab set is fixed
Any RequestSpec mutation from sub-tab interaction — badges are read-only; the only write is setActiveSubTab
Persistence of activeSubTab across app restart — that is T23's job; T5d only puts the field on the Tab record
Lazy / on-demand / code-split panel mounting — decision is mount-all + toggle-visibility to preserve panel state
Sub-tab overflow / responsive collapse — the fixed 6 tabs shrink or scroll via the Tabs molecule's existing behavior; no responsive re-layout
Implementing the external open-on-specific-sub-tab jump-flows (collections-tree / history / command-palette, T18/T19/T20) — T5d only reacts to setActiveSubTab writes
Deep-links / URL-scheme sub-tab navigation, a command-palette 'jump to Auth tab' action, and any test-harness/automation API
Reproducing design/reference.html generated cruft (data-om-* attributes, __OmT wrappers, inline styles, tweaks-panel)

constraints.content: renderer component tiers flow downward only: organisms to molecules to atoms; no sibling-tier or upward imports
renderer depends only on browser/React APIs and preload-exposed window globals — never on Node, Electron, or main
renderer imports cross-module code via the @renderer path alias rather than deep relative paths
co-located tests under __tests__/ next to the code, split .test.tsx (Vitest) and .ct.tsx (Playwright CT)
search the codebase for an existing utility/helper/component before writing anything generic
Introduce no new runtime dependency: compose the existing Tabs molecule, KVTable, and tabsStore rather than adding a tab library
Never mutate zustand state outside a store action: the activeSubTab write goes through the setActiveSubTab tabsStore action
Keep all 6 tabpanels mounted and toggle visibility via CSS; never unmount inactive panels, so KVTable edit state survives a sub-tab switch

Wire the tabpanel WAI-ARIA relationships: role tabpanel, aria-controls, aria-labelledby, and aria-selected mirroring activeSubTab; do not re-implement the tablist keyboard engine Tabs already provides

Author fidelity CTs by reading the section 6 pane-tab values from design/styles.css at test-writing time, and assert resolved computed styles (not screenshot pixels) so a sub-1-percent color change is caught
Visual fidelity is backed by the design-token provenance gate (design/reference.html present -> /breakdown design-manifest + /implement static token-provenance check)
The additive activeSubTab field on the Tab record must not break the existing tabsStore consumers TabBar and RequestBar

risks.risk: A lazy-mount regression silently breaks panel-state preservation (KVTable remounts on switch, losing focus/edits)
risks.mitigation: The focus-survives-switch CT (focus a Params cell, switch to Headers and back, assert same DOM node keeps focus/value) is the go/no-go gate before wiring all 6 panels

risks.risk: A shared/global active-sub-tab index leaks across request tabs (per-tab state bug)
risks.mitigation: Dedicated A->B->A CT: A on Headers, B on Body, switch A->B->A, assert A's activeSubTab is still headers

risks.risk: Fidelity baselines drift (a sub-1-percent color change stays within screenshot tolerance and passes stale)
risks.mitigation: Assert resolved computed styles vs section 6 values in both themes, reading the numbers from design/styles.css at CT-writing time

risks.risk: The additive Tab-record field breaks existing tabsStore consumers
risks.mitigation: Type-check both configs and run the TabBar and RequestBar CTs after the store change

risks.risk: Mounting the composed pane into App.tsx and taking KVTable live introduces integration regressions in the running shell
risks.mitigation: Add a mount/smoke test for the composed request pane and run the full existing suite
